quests.title: Find a field
quests.text: Use the seismograph: it says whether there is an oil or gas field nearby and which way it lies.

quests.title: The drilling rig
quests.text: The drilling rig sinks a steel-cased hole into the field. Its engine needs steel pistons; its drive needs 480 V three-phase: set a dry-type transformer against its terminal box and feed it from a steam turbine on a firebox boiler (Step up to 480 V). A strike leaves a wellhead; a dry hole is reported.

quests.title: An oil well
quests.text: On an oil strike, set the pumpjack over the oil wellhead from behind. It brings up oil, water and gas together.

quests.title: A gas well
quests.text: Strike a field with the rig. On a gas strike the gas wellhead flows by itself. Carry the gas away on steel pipe: one product to a pipe.

quests.title: A stock tank of crude
quests.text: Run the oil to a stock tank. Buckets fill at the tank: crude feeds fireboxes now and a crude unit later.

quests.title: The lease
quests.text: Pipe the wells into a separator: gas off the top, oil and water out of the back. A flare burns gas nobody takes; an injection pump sends water to a disposal well.

quests.title: A casing point
quests.text: A deep field breaks down the open hole under the surface casing. Rack casing joints and oilwell cement in the land rig's substructure and SET CASING (sneak-click the stopped console) within 12 blocks above the field: the seismograph's DEEP ECHO says where.

quests.title: A leak-off test
quests.text: Drill 3 m of new hole below the shoe and sneak-click the console again: the LOT reads the shoe's fracture gradient and the MAASP.

quests.title: Kill a kick through the choke
quests.text: Pipe a choke manifold to the BOP stack's choke line, a mud-gas separator against it venting to a flare, and a remote choke panel on the floor. Shut in a kick and hold drill pipe pressure on the kill sheet's schedule until the well is dead.

quests.title: Oil mud
quests.text: Switch the empty mud tanks to OIL MUD: diesel on a pipe, water to 80/20, calcium chloride flake and the OBM package through the hopper. It does not wash out salt, but watch the pits: a kick hides in it.

quests.title: A storage cavern
quests.text: Leach a cavern in a dome's salt with a brine wellhead, its brine to a disposal well; survey it with the sonar tool; set a storage wellhead on the hole and debrine it with the storage compressor until it is dry.
